nameEn: Manufacture of bearings, gears, gearing and driving elements
description: This class includes the manufacture of ball and roller bearings, gears and gearing, and power transmission equipment.
includes: manufacture of ball and roller bearings
manufacture of gears, gearing and gear boxes
manufacture of clutches and shaft couplings
manufacture of chains (except jewellery chains and bicycle chains)
excludes: manufacture of parts and accessories for motor vehicles (including drive shafts), see 2930
